Arturo Falaschi Short-Term Postdoctoral Fellowships, ICGEB, New Delhi 2025, is an opportunity offered by the International Center for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB), to Ph.D. in Life Science degree holders. The selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of US$ 1,749 and other benefits.
International Center for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB)
To be eligible, the applicant must:
be a citizen of an ICGEB member state
hold a Ph.D. degree in Life Sciences OR
have a minimum of 3 years of research experience
have a good working knowledge of the English language, supported by a proficiency certificate (TOEFL, Cambridge certificate, or equivalent)
The selected fellows will receive a monthly stipend of US$ 1,749.
Travel expenses from the applicant's home country to the ICGEB lab and a return travel ticket upon completion of the fellowship
Reimbursed visa/permit of stay application and renewal cost
Written Statement from the ICGEB Group Leader
A valid identification document (passport or identity card) [
- Recommended passport validity should be at least 12 months]
- This document is not requested when scholastic education has been undertaken in English.]

The ICGEB fellowships selection committee will evaluate complete and endorsed applications received by the closing date. The main criteria for selection include:
The scientific excellence of the project
The qualities of the candidate's curriculum vitae (or résumé) and potential benefit for the home country
ICGEB does not offer financial assistance or administrative support for family members of program participants.
Support for participation in meetings and courses is generally provided by the Group Leader/Principal Investigator.
Proof of English proficiency is not required for those whose secondary or higher education was conducted in English.
Candidates will be notified of the application outcome via email as soon as possible after the application deadline.

Questions: What is the purpose of these fellowships?

These fellowships aim to support short-term research visits to the ICGEB New Delhi component, allowing researchers to collaborate with ICGEB groups, learn new techniques, and gain access to specialized facilities.
Questions: What does the fellowship cover?
The fellowship covers living expenses (a stipend) and potentially some travel costs, but not bench fees or research expenses, for a short-term research stay at ICGEB New Delhi.
Questions: When is the application deadline?
The last date to apply is 30 September 2025.
Questions: How long is the fellowship for?
The duration of the fellowship is 1 to 6 months.
Questions: Is accommodation provided by ICGEB, or do I need to arrange it myself?
ICGEB Trieste has no housing service or accommodation facilities. However, fellows will be provided with a list of possible contacts that offer housing options in Trieste.
